missing_information_behavior: If training type, intensity and performance goal are unclear, do not add a positive recommendation score.
safety_exclusions: Do not imply established benefit for all endurance exercise.
Do not infer a medical need or deficiency.
Do not extrapolate from mixed/high-intensity studies without qualification.
professional_escalation_conditions: Pregnancy, minors, chronic disease or use of medicines/supplements with relevant interactions.
population_and_context: Adults undertaking endurance-only activity; beta-alanine evidence is more context-specific and should not be generalized from high-intensity repeated-effort protocols.
dose_constraints: No dose from this rule; any protocol must be based on separately reviewed evidence for the exact exercise modality and duration.
certainty_and_limitations: NIH ODS Exercise and Athletic Performance fact sheet summarizes mixed and protocol-specific beta-alanine evidence; outcomes differ by activity. This justification remains draft pending source passage verification, critical appraisal, certainty assessment and professional review.
